workloads.name: sustained/cpu-both-cores
workloads.limitation: Near 100% CPU requires measured busy percentages; sensor indication is uncalibrated unless independently calibrated.

workloads.name: physical/contact-to-photon
workloads.reason: Requires owner-operated physical touch stimulus and external optical timing fixture.

workloads.name: audio/usb-only-dac-disabled
workloads.reason: Existing PCM streams the same mixed blocks sent to the local DAC; independent DAC-disable path is not assumed.

workloads.name: audio/external-dac-loopback
workloads.reason: External acquisition fixture required to detect analog gaps/distortion independently.

workloads.name: wireless/wifi-goodput-rtt
workloads.reason: Requires explicitly authorized owned AP/peer and configured traffic endpoint; no network probes are automatic.

workloads.name: wireless/ble-goodput-rtt
workloads.reason: Requires explicitly authorized BLE peer; no scans/probes of unrelated devices.

workloads.name: wireless/espnow-goodput-rtt
workloads.reason: Requires explicitly authorized ESP-NOW peer and owned channel.

workloads.name: wireless/coexistence
workloads.reason: Requires explicitly authorized Wi-Fi/BLE/ESP-NOW peers and separately captured local-workload baseline.

workloads.name: portable/esp32-s3-physical
workloads.reason: Physical S3 board identity/backup/flash authorization required; compile-only is distinct evidence.

workloads.name: portable/esp32-c3-physical
workloads.reason: Physical C3 board identity/backup/flash authorization required; compile-only is distinct evidence.
